div.div: عَطْوٌ and عُطْوٌ and عِطْوٌ, applied to a gazelle, (K, TA,) and to a kid, accord. to Kr, who mentions only the first, as though an inf. n. used as an epithet, (ISd, TA,) Stretching itself up towards the trees, to take therefrom; as also ↓ عَطُوٌّ . (K.) [See also عَاطٍ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
